Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers bringing pets on Aurelia Skyways should review the latest guidance before they travel. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk helps keep each journey calm, safe, and properly prepared.

Please check your carrier, documents, and booking details before you arrive at the airport. <<FACT F078>> If you are traveling with a rabbit, make sure the pet and crate meet the allowance for that booking. <<FACT F064>> Our ground team handles carriers with care between services, and we work to reduce stress for both passengers and animals.

We also ask travelers to keep food, water, and comfort items arranged as advised for the trip. If your plans change, please let the desk know as soon as possible so we can review the arrangement and guide you through the next steps. Clear preparation helps the process stay smooth for everyone involved.

For help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
